findings.finding: The annual meeting on 2026-10-12 at 10:00 ET, inside the window, votes on issuing 707,730 shares (~11% of 6.42M outstanding) to Yangyang Li at $1.80 a share for a personal guaranty, and on raising the 2019 equity plan by 1,284,063 shares (~20%), including up to 500,000 shares for the General Counsel; approval makes up to ~31% potential dilution concrete at a price ~69% below the screen spot.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The meeting is dated 2026-10-12 10:00 ET, the morning of the scored next session, so the vote outcome is known during that session (the results 8-K has a four-business-day clock and may land later, but the meeting itself is in the window). It also carries an unresolved question over who votes the disputed 31% Primo block.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reaction to a meeting result in the baseline; the 2026-06-01 special meeting (reverse split, 8-K 2026-06-05) sat amid the 06-02/06-04/06-05 falls of -8.7%, -8.0% and -13.7% with next-day moves of -5.4%, -13.7% and +1.2%, but those reflect the reverse split, not this kind of issuance.
findings.why_not_priced: The terms have been public since the PRE 14A of 2026-08-19, so most of this is priced; what is not in the close is the outcome itself and the vote on the Primo block. If the market held it, there would be no move on a routine approval; a visible approval of insider stock at $1.80 against a ~$5.83 spot in a retail momentum name can add selling at the margin, while a failed or withdrawn proposal 4 (it needs a majority of the minority) would be a small positive.
